subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The IRS Impersonation Call
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The IRS Impersonation Call.

hook.text: The IRS is calling. You owe back taxes. Police are on the way unless you pay immediately.

buildup.text: Callers spoof the IRS phone number, use agent badges, and cite fake case numbers.

discovery.text: The real IRS always contacts you by mail first and never demands immediate payment by phone.

twist.text: This scam targets immigrants disproportionately — people who fear government authority most.

climax.text: IRS impersonation scams have stolen hundreds of millions from thousands of Americans.

punchline.text: The IRS uses mail, not threats. If they call, it's not them.

quiz.question: How does the real IRS first contact people about tax issues?
